# Code Quality Audit

Invoke the Code Quality Auditor agent to scan the full Copisaurus codebase and generate a structured Markdown report identifying:
- Duplicated logic (with extraction suggestions)
- Boilerplate and unnecessary complexity
- Verbose or unhelpful comments
- Code smells and style inconsistencies
- Testing pattern issues
